1: The number $\log_{25} 1 - \frac{1}{2}\log_{25} 5$ is equal to: A. $-\frac14$ B. $-\frac12$ C. $\frac14$ D. $\frac12$
2: The number $3\sqrt{45}-\sqrt{20}$ is equal to: A. $(7\cdot5)^{1/2}$ B. $5^{1/2}$ C. $7$ D. $7\cdot5^{1/2}$
3: During a seasonal sale a coat with an original value of 240 zl was marked down to 200 zl. So the price of this coat was reduced by: A. 16 2/3% of its original value. B. 20% of its original value. C. 40% of its original value. D. 83 1/3% of its original value.
4: The value of the expression $\dfrac{3^{-1}}{\left(-\frac{1}{9}\right)^{-2}}\cdot 81$ is equal to: A. $\frac13$ B. $-\frac13$ C. $3$ D. $-3$
5: The value of the expression $(2-\sqrt3)^2-(\sqrt3-2)^2$ is equal to: A. $-2\sqrt3$ B. $0$ C. $6$ D. $8\sqrt3$
8: The equation $(x^2-3x)(x^2+1)=0$ in the set of real numbers has exactly: A. one solution. B. two solutions. C. three solutions. D. four solutions.
9: The function f is defined for every real x by $f(x)=\dfrac{x-k}{x^2+1}$, where k is some real number. This function satisfies $f(1)=2$. The value of the coefficient k in the formula of this function is equal to: A. -3 B. 3 C. -4 D. 4
11: The quadratic function f is given by the formula $f(x)=(x-13)^2-256$. One of the zeros of this function is the number -3. The other zero of the function f is: A. -29 B. -23 C. 23 D. 29
14: The quadratic function f, defined by $f(x)=-(x-1)(x-5)$, attains: A. a minimum value equal to 3. B. a minimum value equal to 4. C. a maximum value equal to 3. D. a maximum value equal to 4.
15: The sequence $(a_n)$ is defined by $a_n=(-1)^n\cdot\frac{n+1}{2}$ for every natural number $n\ge1$. The third term of this sequence is equal to: A. 2 B. -2 C. 3 D. -1
16: The four-term sequence $(-2, 1, x, y)$ is geometric. The sum of all terms of this sequence is equal to: A. $-\frac54$ B. $-4$ C. $-\frac14$ D. $-\frac{15}{4}$
17: A circle has radius 3. The perimeter of the sector of this circle with central angle $30°$ is equal to: A. $\frac34\pi$ B. $\frac12\pi$ C. $\frac34\pi+6$ D. $\frac12\pi+6$
18: Angle $\alpha$ is acute and $\cos\alpha=\dfrac{2\sqrt6}{7}$. The sine of angle $\alpha$ is equal to: A. $\frac{24}{49}$ B. $\frac57$ C. $\frac{25}{49}$ D. $\frac{\sqrt6}{7}$
19: In circle O, the central angle $\beta$ and the inscribed angle $\alpha$ are subtended by the same arc. Angle $\beta$ has a measure $40°$ greater than angle $\alpha$. The measure of angle $\beta$ is equal to: A. $40°$ B. $80°$ C. $100°$ D. $120°$
20: The area of an equilateral triangle with height 3 is equal to: A. $\frac{3\sqrt3}{4}$ B. $\frac{9\sqrt3}{4}$ C. $3\sqrt3$ D. $6\sqrt3$
21: Each of the interior angles of a regular decagon has a measure of: A. $120°$ B. $135°$ C. $144°$ D. $150°$
24: In the coordinate system (x, y), point $A=(-1,-4)$ is a vertex of parallelogram $ABCD$. Point $S=(2,2)$ is the center of symmetry of this parallelogram. The length of diagonal $AC$ of parallelogram $ABCD$ is equal to: A. $\sqrt5$ B. $2\sqrt5$ C. $3\sqrt5$ D. $6\sqrt5$
25: [Info for tasks 25-26: every edge of a regular hexagonal prism has length 6.] The total surface area of this prism is equal to: A. $216+18\sqrt3$ B. $216+54\sqrt3$ C. $216+216\sqrt3$ D. $216+108\sqrt3$
26: [Same regular hexagonal prism, every edge 6.] The cosine of the angle of inclination of the longer diagonal of this prism to the plane of its base is equal to: A. $\frac12$ B. $\frac{2}{\sqrt5}$ C. $\frac{1}{\sqrt5}$ D. $\frac{\sqrt3}{2}$
27: In a regular quadrilateral pyramid, the ratio of the lateral surface area to the base area is equal to 12. It follows that in this pyramid, the ratio of the slant height of a lateral face to the base edge is equal to: A. 24 B. 3 C. 6 D. 4
28: [Bar chart: number of employees vs. gross salary for January 2023: 4800 zl - 10 employees, 5100 zl - 36, 5500 zl - 5, 5900 zl - 25, 6400 zl - 18, 7500 zl - 4, 8600 zl - 2.] The average gross salary of all one hundred employees of this company for January 2023 is equal to: A. 5690 zl B. 5280 zl C. 6257 zl D. 5900 zl
29: The number of all four-digit natural numbers whose decimal digits do not repeat is: A. $9\cdot10\cdot10\cdot10\cdot10$ B. $9\cdot9\cdot9\cdot9$ C. $10\cdot9\cdot8\cdot7$ D. $9\cdot9\cdot8\cdot7$
31: The sequence $(3x^2+5x,\ x^2,\ 20-x^2)$ is arithmetic. Find x.
33: Given is an isosceles trapezoid $ABCD$, in which base $CD$ has length 6, leg $AD$ has length 4, and angles $BAD$ and $ABC$ have measure $60°$ [figure: trapezoid ABCD with D and C on top, A and B on bottom]. Find the area of this trapezoid.
35: From the set of five numbers $\{1,2,3,4,5\}$ we draw without replacement, one after another, two numbers. Calculate the probability of event A: both drawn numbers are odd.
36: Points $A=\left(\frac{22}{5},-\frac{21}{5}\right)$, $B=(6,7)$ and $C=(-9,2)$ are vertices of triangle $ABC$. The perpendicular bisector of side $AB$ of this triangle intersects side $BC$ at point D. Find the coordinates of point D.
